description: This Java class 'EnforcedThingFlattener' is responsible for flattening 'Thing' objects with associated enforcers into a list of pointer-value pairs suitable for indexing or storage. It processes JSON representations of 'Thing' objects, converts them into BSON documents, and incorporates permission enforcement data. It provides static methods for flattening JSON objects and methods for handling different JSON types, including arrays and nested objects. The class utilizes external classes like 'Enforcer', 'JsonObject', and BSON utilities to perform its operations.

classes.name: EnforcedThingFlattener
classes.description: A utility class that flattens a JSON representation of a 'Thing' with enforcer context into a stream of BSON documents suitable for indexing.
